summary: VidBee web (video/audio downloader). Saved 4 views: (1) downloads-home – the main download list with platform filter chips, cookies tip banner, active queue with progress and history; (2) subscriptions – the RSS subscription feed with channel avatar strip and a card grid; (3) settings – the General settings page with its section sidebar; (4) add-subscription – the Add subscription modal form. Not captured: the "Download" format dialog after fetching a URL. It worked, but the harness rejected it as too similar to the home view. The Tools nav button does nothing in the web build, and /tools returns Not Found. Download rows have no detail page. Filtered subscription views and other settings tabs were left out as near-duplicates.
